      @keyframes hero-reveal {
        0% {
          opacity: 0;
          transform: translateY(24px);
        }
        to {
          opacity: 1;
          transform: translateY(0);
        }
      }
      .hero-reveal {
        animation: 0.65s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1) both hero-reveal;
      }
      @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
        .hero-reveal {
          animation: none;
        }
      }
      @keyframes marquee-trusted {
        0% {
          transform: translate(0);
        }
        to {
          transform: translate(-50%);
        }
      }
      @keyframes marquee-tech {
        0% {
          transform: translate(0);
        }
        to {
          transform: translate(-50%);
        }
      }
      .animate-marquee-trusted {
        contain: layout style;
        width: max-content;
        animation: 40s linear infinite marquee-trusted;
        display: flex;
      }
      .animate-marquee-trusted:hover {
        animation-play-state: paused;
      }
      .animate-marquee-tech {
        contain: layout style;
        width: max-content;
        animation: 100s linear infinite marquee-tech;
        display: flex;
      }
      .animate-marquee-tech:hover {
        animation-play-state: paused;
      }
      @keyframes blob-float {
        0% {
          transform: translate(0) scale(1);
        }
        33% {
          transform: translate(30px, -50px) scale(1.1);
        }
        66% {
          transform: translate(-20px, 20px) scale(0.9);
        }
        to {
          transform: translate(0) scale(1);
        }
      }
      .bg-grid {
        color: #1717170d;
        color: lab(7.78201% -0.0000149012 0/0.05);
        background-image:
          linear-gradient(90deg, currentColor 1px, #0000 1px),
          linear-gradient(currentColor 1px, #0000 1px);
        background-size: 50px 50px;
        -webkit-mask-image: radial-gradient(circle, #000 0%, #0000 85%);
        mask-image: radial-gradient(circle, #000 0%, #0000 85%);
      }
      .dark .bg-grid {
        color: #fafafa06;
        color: lab(98.26% 0 0/0.025);
      }
      @keyframes neon-outline-sweep {
        0% {
          opacity: 0;
          -webkit-mask-position: 100% 0;
          mask-position: 100% 0;
        }
        15% {
          opacity: 0.95;
        }
        50% {
          opacity: 1;
          -webkit-mask-position: 50% 0;
          mask-position: 50% 0;
        }
        85% {
          opacity: 0.95;
        }
        to {
          opacity: 0;
          -webkit-mask-position: 0 0;
          mask-position: 0 0;
        }
      }

        filter: drop-shadow(0 0 6px #9333ea99) drop-shadow(0 0 14px #7e22ce66)
          drop-shadow(0 0 24px #6b21a840);

      /** Common styles across all window sizes. */
      .swg-dialog,
      .swg-toast,
      .publisher-toast {
        box-sizing: border-box;
      }

      .swg-toast {
        background-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 1) !important;
        max-height: 46px !important;
      }

      .publisher-toast {
        background-color: transparent !important;
        max-width: 360px !important;
      }

      .swg-toast,
      .publisher-toast {
        position: fixed !important;
        bottom: 0 !important;
        z-index: 2147483647 !important;
        border: none !important;
      }

      /**
  * Wide desktop screen support, when width is >= 871px and height is >= 641px.
  */
      @media (min-width: 871px) and (min-height: 641px) {
        .swg-dialog.swg-wide-dialog {
          left: -435px !important;
        }

        .swg-dialog.swg-wide-dialog,
        .swg-toast,
        .publisher-toast {
          width: 870px !important;
        }
      }

      /** Tablet/Medium screen support, when width OR height is <= 640px. */
      @media (max-width: 640px), (max-height: 640px) {
        .swg-dialog,
        .swg-toast {
          width: 480px !important;
          left: -240px !important;
          margin-inline-start: calc(100vw - 100vw / 2) !important;
          border-top-left-radius: 8px !important;
          border-top-right-radius: 8px !important;
          box-shadow:
            rgba(60, 64, 67, 0.3) 0 1px 1px,
            rgba(60, 64, 67, 0.15) 0 1px 4px 1px !important;
        }

        .publisher-toast {
          width: 480px !important;
          left: -240px !important;
          margin-inline-start: calc(100vw - 100vw / 2) !important;
        }

        [dir="rtl"] .swg-dialog,
        [dir="rtl"] .swg-toast,
        [dir="rtl"] .publisher-toast {
          margin-inline-start: calc(100vw - 100vw / 2 - 240px) !important;
        }
      }

      /** Desktop/Large screen support, when width AND height are >= 641px. */
      @media (min-width: 641px) and (min-height: 641px) {
        .swg-dialog,
        .swg-toast,
        .publisher-toast {
          width: 630px !important;
        }

        .swg-dialog {
          left: -315px !important;
          margin-inline-start: calc(100vw - 100vw / 2) !important;
          background-color: transparent !important;
          border: none !important;
        }

        [dir="rtl"] .swg-dialog {
          margin-inline-start: calc(100vw - 100vw / 2 - 315px) !important;
        }

        .swg-toast {
          border-radius: 4px !important;
          bottom: 8px !important;
          box-shadow:
            0 3px 1px -2px rgb(0 0 0 / 20%),
            0 2px 2px 0 rgb(0 0 0 / 14%),
            0 1px 5px 0 rgb(0 0 0 / 12%) !important;
          left: 8px !important;
        }

        .publisher-toast {
          bottom: 8px !important;
          right: 30px !important;
        }
      }

      /** Phone/Small screen support, when width is <= 480px. */
      @media (max-width: 480px) {
        .swg-dialog,
        .swg-toast,
        .publisher-toast {
          width: 100% !important;
          max-width: 100% !important;
          left: 0 !important;
          right: 0 !important;
          margin-inline-start: 0 !important;
        }
      }
